Fictional test correspondence. All people, addresses, decisions and project particulars in this document are invented for a software evaluation.

Record R403 Date 2026-11-04 Email reply

From: Fictional Quantity Surveyor <qs@consense-scenario.invalid>
To: Fictional Coordination Team <team@consense-scenario.invalid>

The optional covered walkway between the school and the housing estate is Works Subject to Excision. Site formation is excluded because the formed platforms are provided under a completed enabling contract. This contract includes excavations in the public road for which an Excavation Permit is required.

Provide both exhibition flats and show flats for the subsidised sale development. The domestic blocks use conventional construction; CON8 volumetric precast components are not included. No PSE submission for such volumetric units is called for.

The Tender is based on precast concrete facades. The Contractor is also permitted to propose precast concrete facade construction under the applicable facade provision.

Regards,
Fictional Quantity Surveyor

Return no guessed values or empty copies of the catalogue. If the source expressly leaves an input pending, not supplied or blank, return that key with value null, its explanation and one exact contiguous unresolved-source quote. Only inputs unmentioned in this part may be omitted. false is an explicit No and [] an explicitly justified empty list. Collections have three states: source-confirmed absence is []; pending, missing information or insufficient facts are null; explicitly provided applicable items are a concrete list. [] requires an exact quote and complete original context establishing absence for this field and scope. A failed search is not absence. Examples: 'No additional tender requirements apply to this project.' -> value []; 'Additional tender requirements remain pending.' or 'No requirement can be established from the available facts.' -> value null; 'Provide a signed plan with the tender.' -> value [{"text":"Provide a signed plan with the tender."}]. Fictional test correspondence. All people, addresses, decisions and project particulars in this document are invented for a software evaluation.

Record R406 Date 2026-11-09 Email reply

From: Fictional Quantity Surveyor <qs@consense-scenario.invalid>

All foundation design is by the Employer. Contractor designed foundations are not included. The Contractor executes the four work scopes listed in the complete responsibility schedule below.

Component | Scope of work | Contractor designs | Contractor executes

piling | Bored piles beneath Housing Blocks 1 and 2 | No | Yes

pilecaps | Pile caps beneath Housing Blocks 1 and 2 | No | Yes

footings | Shallow footings supporting the primary school | No | Yes

other | Retaining walls beside the school playground | No | Yes

The shallow footings serve the primary school building. Footings serving buildings or major external structures are therefore included.

The Employer will complete its foundation design after tender acceptance. The design is not established at tender acceptance. Tenderers are not required to submit a foundation design with the Tender.

The proposal for a design related quotation before instructing a Variation remains under review. No decision adopting or rejecting that optional requirement has been issued.

Regards,
Fictional Quantity Surveyor

Roof refuge floor and warranty decisions

Fictional test correspondence. All people, addresses, decisions and project particulars in this document are invented for a software evaluation.

Record R409 Date 2026-11-12 Meeting minutes

Attendees: Fictional Project Architect, Structural Engineer, Procurement Officer and Quantity Surveyor. Recorder: Fictional Quantity Surveyor.

Roofing installation is included on the school and the housing blocks. The roofing installation warranty is required. Refuge floor installation is excluded, so there is no refuge floor installation warranty to insert.

A warranty for the other waterproofing installations is required. The separate waterproofing scope reply will supply its complete specification area list.

An acrylic paint warranty is not required. A wall tiling warranty is not required. Play equipment is excluded from this contract. Impact Absorbing Surfacing Materials are included at the outdoor mobility exercise area.

The requirement for an epoxy coated cast iron pipe installation warranty has not been decided. The drainage designer will confirm this matter separately.
